# Action Audio

> Connecticut mobile electronics specialists since 1983, with electronics in Wethersfield and vehicle detailing in Hartford.

## Services
- [Services](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/services.html): auto electronics repair, auto detailing work, and auto electrical installation.
- Brands include Alpine, Rockford Fosgate, Pioneer, Diamond Audio, Kenwood, Powerbass, and MTX. Compatibility, stock, and pricing must be confirmed with the store.

## Stores
- [Wethersfield](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/wethersfield.html): Remote starters, car audio, electronics repair and installation. 105 Silas Deane Hwy, Wethersfield, CT 06109. Motts Shopping Center. Phone: (860) 667-6330.
- [Hartford](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/hartford.html): Interior and exterior auto detailing. 2814 Main St, Hartford, CT 06120.
- Both stores: Monday–Saturday, 9am–6pm Eastern. Sunday closed. Holiday hours may differ.

## Customer resources
- [Book an appointment](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/book.html): select a store, service, date, and time. A request is not confirmed until staff confirms it.
- [Electronics](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/electronics.html): electronics at Wethersfield; manufacturer examples are clearly labeled. Do not infer stock or prices from brand names.
- [Our story](https://actionaudiostorellc.com/about.html): founded as a CB radio store in 1983.
